records.description: FoxyDNS encrypts your DNS lookups using DNS over HTTPS (DoH) and routes them through the FoxyDNS network — a distributed infrastructure operated by FoxyFy. You can choose how your DNS is handled, including an EU-only mode that keeps resolution within European infrastructure.

records.name: MotoProGestion
records.tagline: MotoProGestion: No es caridad — Es justicia tecnológica
records.description: Digitaliza tu taller con MotoProGestion. Genera órdenes de servicio profesionales, integra API de WhatsApp para notificaciones automáticas y empodera a tu equipo con una pantalla exclusiva para mecánicos. Su diseño es 100% usable desde cualquier dispositivo (móvil o PC). Gestiona el historial clínico por placa, inventario y POS en un ecosistema fluido y potente. Es la herramienta definitiva para llevar la administración de tu negocio al siguiente nivel profesional.

records.name: LTX 2.5
records.tagline: Ltx 2.5 AI Video Generator
records.description: Create AI videos with Ltx 2.5. Turn text prompts or reference images into short clips, refine motion and style, and export content for social posts, ads, and product pages.

records.name: FlowBricks
records.tagline: Lead management built for real estate brokers & builders
records.description: FlowBricks is a simple real estate workflow software for agents, brokers, and builders to manage leads, follow-ups, and sales in one place.Explore our marketplace to connect with agents and brokers.Managing a team across multiple projects,FlowBricks provides a clean and structured system to stay on top of your daily work.

records.name: Ryō - Smart Toilet
records.tagline: Smart Toilet
records.description: Ryō smart toilets with integrated bidet — US warehouse, 2-year warranty, free freight delivery in 3–7 days. Heated seat, auto flush, warm water wash. The smart toilet that actually backs you up. Ryō | Smart Toilet with Bidet — 2-Year Warranty | Free US Shipping

records.name: Novel AI
records.tagline: One Idea, One Novel
records.description: Turn one sentence into a complete novel. NovelAI generates outlines and chapter-by-chapter content (3,000–5,000 words each) across mystery, romance, fantasy, sci-fi and more. Free to read, free to write, free to share.

records.name: Cut-O-Mat
records.tagline: Plan the cut and cut the plan.
records.description: For everybody who doesn't want to waste time or money when cutting material for your DIY projects. Cut-O-Mat keeps your cuts organised, off cuts small and shopping lists accurate.

records.name: Cranny
records.tagline: The map of places that don't exist anywhere else.
records.description: Cranny is a free app for discovering and sharing hidden gems — viewpoints, benches, fire pits, and secret places real people actually found. Not on Google Maps. Only on Cranny.

records.name: LISTIDO
records.tagline: All in one productive app
records.description: 📱 LISTIDO – the productivity app for habit tracker 🌟 ABOUT LISTIDO Build good habits, break bad ones, stay focused and track your mood. Everything you need for habit tracker in daily life – in one app. 🚀 START TODAY Your productivity journey begins with one step. Download LISTIDO now! #LISTIDO #Habits #Productivity #Pomodoro #MoodTracker #StreakPoints #ToDos #SelfImprovement #Focus

records.name: RayOnn
records.tagline: Turn studying into an addictive multiplayer game !
records.description: Get a full workspace (to-do, calendar, habit tracker, stats, sessions), earn XP, unlock levels and rewards, and compete with friends in groups. Join groups and do your best to climb the leaderboards. Track your progress and stay motivated. A social, gamified way to finally enjoy working!

records.name: Creative Home Improvement LLC
records.tagline: Strong Homes Start with Smart Exterior Upgrades
records.description: Expert home improvement sYour home is more than just a place to live. It is where your family feels safe, happy, and comfortable. That is why choosing the right home improvement services is very important. If you are looking for the best replacement windows, vinyl siding installation, or a trusted residential roofing contractor, you are in the right place.

records.name: AI Development Company
records.tagline: We build efficient systems that support business expansion
records.description: We build software solutions focused on efficient development and business growth. Our approach ensures well-structured systems and long-term adaptability while supporting lead generation through stronger digital presence and customer reach. Each solution is aligned with business goals to support growth and sustainable expansion across competitive markets with continuous improvement and better engagement opportunities.
